body.statement: For \(P_{\mathrm w,\sigma}\), the forward residual is independent of \(X\), the reverse conditional-mean residual is dependent on \(Y\), and, with \(m_2=\mathbb E[Z^2]\), \(C_{P_{\mathrm w,\sigma}}((Y,X);2,1)\ge1/2-\sigma^2m_2/\operatorname{Var}(X+X^2)\). Hence the correcting gain is positive for sufficiently small \(\sigma\) and converges to \(1/2\). The support-closure relation holds on \([0,1]\times[-\sigma,2+\sigma]\), and the Condition 19 differential identity fails on an interior open set.
body.justification: The witness supplies a quantitative, scale-invariant calibration of the primitive certificate in the smallest graph.
body.gap: Reisach et al. (2023, Sections 3 and 5) analyze normalized explained variance but not its combination with exact residual dependence in GENE Equation (6).
body.consumer: Implementers obtain an analytic two-node test case whose population gain approaches one half.
